items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Well, Jimmy Mitchelle. Jimmy was, he was a sweetheart. You know, I didn't know he could sing until we got to New York. So, he told me, he said Hawk, let me sing that. That's how he started being a vocalist in the band.

ctx.x: dormitory, the dormitory doors were locked at 11:00. So, all the way from the jam, we had to go up the fire escape. So, we went through the fire escape. So, the dean got tired of us coming up the fire escape. He knew where we were. So, he just left the door opened for us. So, he was tired of that, you know, although they gave us a break on account of us going out travelling with the band for the school.

Well, Jimmy Mitchelle. Jimmy was, he was a sweetheart. You know, I didn't know he could sing until we got to New York. So, he told me, he said Hawk, let me sing that. That's how he started being a vocalist in the band. So, once he started to sing and it went over very nice, I liked it.
So, that's how he got started to sing. He was the third alto player in the section at that time.
